answer: Recursive Flow Circuit Partitioning measures the conductance drop when an edge is artificially split, treating clustered nodes like a weeping willow branch that bends under concentrated weight. To prevent sybil manipulation, the routing protocol requires every transaction path to maintain high path independence against a dual mirror reference graph. An attacker trying to siphon network resources pays a heavy transmission penalty, as fragmented loops consume excess routing energy without harvesting any protocol nectar.
